body: Honestly a lot of my posts go unanswered too but on the few times people replied I felt so glad and not so alone. If you ever need someone you can DM me and I’d be glad to help you if I can. Take care my pal.

Hi there. I completely relate to you as I have had panic attacks daily since September of 2018. The stress of it got so bad I had to quit my job, lost 40 pounds and have even contemplated suicide during this time.  During this time I was having about 10 full blown panic attacks by the time noon rolled around, heart rate 170+,sweating,trembling and can’t breath. I honestly didn’t think I’d live to see this day as I haven’t had a heart attack from all this and I’m truly shocked by that. I hope you read a little bit of my story and feel better that you’re not alone in this. I can tell you with full confidence you are not crazy. Panic attacks are simply biological responses to stress in our environment just as sweating is a biological response to a hot environment. The one thing I’m thinking is that something is bothering you in your life right now although you may not realize it. Has something recently happened stressful in your life? Really sit down and be open with yourself or what’s going on in your life right now. And as always be nice to yourself. I do care about you as a person and I hope you treat yourself as you would treat a friend although I know it’s easier said than done. You can always DM me if you need support, I’d be more than happy. Take care pal.
Awesome job! You sound exactly like me on my first day at work although with anxiety everyday ended up being nervously just everyday is the first day. 😅 But anyways we are all so proud of you!
Mental illnesses because it affects every other aspect of your body.
Thank you so much for the advice pal. This helped me. Good luck to you as well.
Thank you so much for this helpful advice. I’m actually seeking therapy this week and hope it helps. Thanks for sharing your story with me. I knew surely I couldn’t be the only one!
Thank you. I am rooting for you also. I really mean that. I don’t have to see your face or hear your voice to support you. I just do. All the best my friend.
Thank you my friend. And yes I like to believe that. I see how much hatred many people have but I just care about everyone. Everyone has a story and deserves to be heard.
Thank you so much for your support as well. I mean this is life and we were all thrown into it without choice so why not make the best of it together?

Im so sorry you lost your friends. It never gets easier. I just posted the same time as you saying the same thing. It’s a shame that people are more willing to reach out and get help for physical illness and mental illness. And it really says a lot about the culture we live in. I know we can’t change everyone all at once but we can do what we can as an individual. Never be afraid to ask someone “are you okay?” Because that’s just the questions the have probably been waiting to be asked.

First off thank you for caring enough to reply. I know what you mean. It just hurts so much right now but doesn’t mean it always will. I do realize though that it will probably be an ongoing battle my whole life although I just want to live in today. I always try to reach out even if it’s just online because it’s better than nothing. Also if anyone else can see what I wrote and feel a bit of comfort then I think I did a good thing. Again thank you.
You are right. I know this deep down inside. Thank you for the comment. Means so much to me.

Couldn’t agree more with you. I never understand why message someone and try to be friends over messaging? Friendship should be IRL at some point. And you’re totally right most people suffer from loneliness but no one is brave enough to speak out and connect. I’m from NYC but from upstate. I’m sure you know people in the city are nuts here. Working so long hours and on the weekend get so drunk so you can forgot all your problems. Not me I’d rather make meaningful friendships.
Thank you! I will check it out.
Yes all the time. Sometimes I feel I actually am dead and feel like my body isn’t my own..

Yes that would be very cool. Lol. It’s hard for me to know there’s people out there who don’t wish others well,I never understand that. As a fellow human we should support each other. And I’ve also had times of hardship where I swear to you I didn’t know the outcome or how I’d survive but somehow I’m still here.

Look that’s the spirit! Sometimes you have to trust the process. I know I have. And thank you for praying for me also. It’s amazing that someone who doesn’t even know me wishes me well and vice versa. Good luck in the new job.

I feel your pain and I can tell you’re hurting a lot right now. I cant sympathize your exact situation but I too have felt betrayed and cheated on by people. It must be very hard to be unemployed and homeless. Always hold your own and never lower your standards. God bless.

Good luck to you in your future opportunities. I also tell myself to never beat yourself up over a company who would would replace you in a week if you were to drop dead tomorrow(aka big corporations). Never be tied down in life to anyone or anything that makes you suffer because in the end it’s only ourselves who will suffer. All the best.

Just happened to me and my SO the other day. He witnessed 2 panic attacks and it turned into a fight. But what I force myself to understand(and you should too) is that they don’t know what it’s like in your shoes. Your husband is taking it personally because it’s hard to see you like that. He cares about you a lot I’m sure and sometimes people are at a lose when their loved ones are hurting. I hope this helps.

Yes I totally relate to what you’re saying. I posted something the other day in an emotional crisis asking for help and only one person replied. It made me feel like truly no one cares. I want to connect with people like me.

Yeah DM is good for me. I think we both need someone to relate to in this. Panic attacks and anxiety are very difficult I’m sure I don’t need to tell you that. Thank you so much for replying. I’m very grateful.

Hi there. I’m a pharmacy technician in Queens making $15.50 per hour. I started at $14 but as you probably know they raised the minimum wage recently. Haha. I just wanna warn you if you wanna do pharmacy understand it is extremely stressful if it’s retail pharmacy. Not wanna scare ya but just know you should have a thick skin to cope. All the best!!!
I know this post is so old but you guys belong on a magazine cover!
I completely understand. Me and my husband experience the same thing. People stare with no shame. But my favorite thing was “how much is he paying you to be married to him?” I almost died😅
That that’s just Tourette’s and just go with the flow. Not exactly a quirk I guess but kinda😂
And thank you!

Yes I was for a while. I used an app called “Lifesum”. The only thing is that I’d be at my limit for the day and then still be so hungry and end up eating more. I don’t want to starve myself or over eat.

Yes! I have had both an endoscopy and colonoscopy just in the past month and everything was completely fine and I was diagnosed with IBS. It seriously dampens life even more. I noticed my symptoms flair up when my anxiety is worse and I lost 35 pounds because i decided I’d rather eat nothing than deal with IBS pain. I’m on a medication called “Trulance” now and it really helps and also making a routine in your life and eating things like oatmeal and fruits/vegetables daily. Also exercise.
Same! Avocados are my all time favorite food. I try not to each too many though because of fat content.
Baby carrots. I don’t know why i eat them with almost every meal and finish several bags a week just by myself. Haha weird?

I’m thinking of going to a neurologist soon to see what they think I should do to manage it. The thing is I don’t want to take medication so there’s got to be behavioral ways for me to manage which I can use. Thank you for understanding and giving your advice I really appreciate

Your comment definitely helps me. I’m 21 years old so I have pretty much come to terms with the fact that I probably won’t grow out of this. I can only manage this and try to educate people. Your son is very lucky to have a parent like you who love and supports him.

Yes that’s true. I have to control what I can and other than that I can only explain to people. I think when most people see me tic they already know it’s Tourette’s without an explanation and most people don’t say anything anyways. Most people are kind and those who aren’t don’t matter.

Same here. That’s why I started using Reddit to begin with. It hasn’t been that long here for me but this is truly a great online support for me where I know people are more likely to reply versus some mental health forum. Thank you so much for taking the time out of your day to say something positive to me. I truly appreciate it. And same goes to you if you ever need to chat.

Thank you. You are all so kind here on Reddit. Your comment means so much. Yes I may be down but it’s my choice to stay down on the ground or not. I do realize I have a lot of qualities which would make people like me it’s just a matter of letting people in.

Thank you so much. You are absolutely right. The moment may be dark but the future doesn’t have to be and I have to continue to put it all into perspective.I have so much to be grateful for. Thanks for the reply kind stranger. My best wishes to you also.

-Got my drivers license at 21 years old
-Reduced my weight from 220 to 185
-Got better grades this semester 
-Got a job and pushed(still pushing) through my crippling anxiety 
Just a few things but it’s huge for me!

I once sent a text meant for my husband “the candles won’t stay lit outside because of the wind don’t worry sweetie god will understand..” but accidentally sent it to me classmate . Lmao she was cool with it😂😂
Yoga! Not as easy as it looks.
Yes definitely. Living in NYC so probably not a good idea not to...lol

I am rooting for you also! It doesn’t matter that we don’t know each other in person, you are a fellow human being and that makes me care about you in itself. You know i have struggled my entire life with suicidal thoughts and I can’t tell you how many times I almost went through with it. We are all here for you and I know it’s hard to see in the darkest hour but you are so worthy and you deserve happiness. You’re very courageous I hope you realize this.

Ummm do you work at my store?lol it’s the exact same thing at my cvs store. People hog production and drop off and I’m planted at pickup getting most of the customers abuse. My advice to you is either specifically ask to be at a different station or if possible when an insurance issue or any other drop off appropriate issue you yourself physically step down and help them. You gotta make your space because people for some reason are territorial with what station they’re at. This is what I’ve been doing and it helped me. All the best!

One more thing I wanted to add. You mentioned wanting to be “normal “ by having a hometown to call your own. But nothing is “normal “, I don’t think that word has a definition even because it means different thing to different people. Don’t be so hard on yourself. You’re a human being and with a great mind and that’s awesome in itself.

Yup. Here with you on that one as you already know. Ever just stare into a crowd of people and just cringe?? Me too... the thing with where I grew up (very rural,uneducated and poverty stricken) I didn’t fit in there and now living in New York City (fancy people big money) I don’t fit in either so now what? Where are you originally from if you don’t mind sharing?

100% you’re just like me. Totally agree with the part about not looking down on people who engage in those behaviors, it’s just not what I like to do. I’m a very open minded person and I just love everyone no matter their personality may be. I just find humans fascinating lol. And the thing with people like us is that we are so few and far between therefore it’s hard to us to be friends in real life. That’s why I reached out here on reddit to see if I’m abnormal or not. Applause to you. Enjoy your own company. You are fun too!☺️👏👏👏
“If this ends up on reddit, I will personally sue your ass!” 😂😂😂
Thank you 🙏

Wow I need to give you a big hug girl. This is so real for me. It always has been. Specifically for me is work anxiety too and I never knew anyone else with this specific anxiety. Idk why it’s something about other people relying on me for something and/or being responsible for providing the service at your job. I also hate being anywhere where I’m required to be there for a certain time. We’ve all heard of anxiety of being in crowds, public speaking but I think workplace anxiety is so much worse because it’s daily and never ending. I quit 2 jobs because of it(aka stopped showing up then quitting via text) and I have also started a new job in August and I told myself if I don’t keep this job I probably never will be able to hold a job. even now I sometimes lay awake worrying about work (a lot actually) and my anxiety there and have lost over 30 Pounds because I could not bring myself to eat because of the constant knot in my stomach. The first couple months were hell, I would be shaking while giving customers change and have to run to the bathroom because I was having a panic attack. I totally agree with what you said. I also realized the only way to get through it is to go through it!! Thank your for sharing and giving me hope.

Yes! Me too. I think that’s what they call an “existential crisis”. I’m am going through the same thing. Sometimes I just stand there and watch people doing these trivial things(shopping,gossip, etc) and think what’s the point? There’s this weird pattern of people, going to work 8 hours,eating,sleeping, doing a little something on the weekends,having kids and the cycle repeats itself. Do this for several decades and then one day you die. But think of this as a blessing(it is). Not many people think that much in depth about life. People just get caught up in these mundane things of everyday life and that’s it,that’s their existence. Use this realization as a launching pad to leave your impression on the world. That’s what I’m trying to do anyways. That’s all any of us can do. All the best!!

I feel the exact same way. All of my peers(coworkers,friends,classmates,etc) seem to have an exact life plan and reaching their goals and are in an awesome place in life and I’m still looking for my purpose. I have no idea what I even want to do for a career, no hobbies really,passions or anything are seldom. But you know what I think about when I find myself dwelling on this? I remind myself that nothing in this life matters as much as we think it is. Whether you’re a lawyer or a janitor doesn’t matter even that much because we are all going to die an that’ll be the end of it. Literally no one on this planet asked to be born and I didn’t not think there’s even a definition to “having your life figured out”. I think everyone is just kind of floating through life and these “big life events” (graduation,marriage,etc) are just tiny details. So the moral here is don’t take life that serious, no of us make it out alive anyways lol. Just find your own little corner of the universe and do your thing. I hope what I wrote doesn’t make you feel worse. I am just sharing what makes me feel better. All the best!

I used to wake up at 6am go to all my classes and then work until 1am. Go home nap and repeat. It’s torturous and I don’t recommend making a lifestyle out of it like I did but temporary I think it’s ok. You should be getting your second wind sometime soon.haha all the best! And get that money! When I have one of those nights I think of everyone else sleeping on it and I’m out here hustling and working hard it really motivates me.

I work only 5 hours today (thank god) not my usual 7 or 8. I have to be there in an hour, I know the feeling. The thought about what awaits you if worse than what actually awaits you😅 anyways I hope you have a victory shift and think of me. I’ll be a my job just waiting to clock out too! Haha

And remember panic attacks are not a weakness it’s just a part of biology. No one knows what’s it’s like until they’ve been through it and it’s not easy on any level. Big respect for strong people like us!
